The Indie App Sales promotion is back, with exclusive discounts for hundreds of iOS, iPadOS, visionOS, macOS, and watchOS apps running through July 30. Here are the details.

Indie App Sales July edition is now live

Featuring more than 850 listings for iOS, iPadOS, visionOS, macOS, watchOS, Android, Mac, and Windows apps, in addition to web-based platforms, the newest edition of Indie App Sales is now live, with deals running officially through July 30.

This year’s deals span roughly 30 categories, including:

  • Al and Smart Assistants
  • Books
  • Business
  • Developer Tools
  • Education
  • Entertainment
  • Finance
  • Food and Drink
  • Games
  • Graphics and Design
  • Health and Fitness
  • Lifestyle
  • Magazines and Newspapers
  • Medical
  • Music
  • Navigation
  • News
  • Photo and Video
  • Productivity
  • Reference
  • Shopping
  • Smart Home and Home Automation
  • Social Networking
  • Sports
  • Stickers
  • Travel
  • Utilities
  • Weather

Indie App Sales is a great opportunity to support indie developers and small teams, as well as discover hidden gems you might not otherwise come across.

Apple users will likely recognize several of the apps on offer, including Leitmotif’s Kaleidoscope (with 40% off the first two years of a subscription), Gentler Stories’ Gentler Streak and The Outsiders (both with 40% off annual plans), and frequent 9to5Mac partner CardPointers (which is offering 50% off its annual and lifetime plans).

Be sure to check out the Indie App Sales website, and send it to your friends for extra karma points. Supporting indie developers, particularly at a time like this, has never been so important, and this is a great initiative for all involved.
